latest_release.name: v7.3.0
latest_release.body:
> [!WARNING]  
> This release patches the brotli RCE CVE-2026-111497 in CI and deployment environments. Brotli compression is not supported in the API, and the overall risk is low, however it is recommended to upgrade regardless.

## What's Changed
* Migrate templates from *ngIf/*ngSwitch to @if/@switch control flow by @Noah231515 in https://github.com/Receipt-Wrangler/receipt-wrangler/pull/728
* Add API key scope picker and display in UI by @Noah231515 in https://github.com/Receipt-Wrangler/receipt-wrangler/pull/730
* Replace Python IMAP client with native Go email polling by @Noah231515 in https://github.com/Receipt-Wrangler/receipt-wrangler/pull/729
* Upgrade Node.js to 24.22.1 across CI and Docker by @Noah231515 in https://github.com/Receipt-Wrangler/receipt-wrangler/pull/731


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Receipt-Wrangler/receipt-wrangler/compare/v7.2.0...v7.3.0

detail.readme:
# Welcome to Receipt Wrangler

This repository contains the Receipt Wrangler API, Desktop app and Mobile app.
Previously these were separate repositories, they are now merged into one monolith repository for simplicity.

To get started, check out the directories containing each application.
